capital.evidence_quote: Moscow is the capital and largest city of the Russian Federation

sources.title: Central Bank of the Russian Federation

currency.evidence_quote: The Russian Ruble (RUB) is the official currency; foreign Visa/Mastercard cards are suspended due to sanctions

timezone.evidence_quote: Moscow Standard Time operates on UTC+3; the country spans 11 time zones from UTC+2 to UTC+12

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential alternating current supply across Russia is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout Russia is standard 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European standard Type C and Schuko Type F round two-pin sockets are universal in Russia

sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia (MVD)

police.evidence_quote: Dial 102 from mobile phones or 02 from landlines for emergency police assistance

sources.title: Ministry of Health of the Russian Federation

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 103 for emergency medical services and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 101 for fire and rescue emergency services

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the nationwide unified emergency dispatch number operational across Russia

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Specialized Tourist Police battalions patrol Red Square and central pedestrian zones in Moscow

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Devam eden askeri çatışma, uçuş kısıtlamaları ve bankacılık yaptırımları nedeniyle Batılı dışişleri bakanlıkları Rusya'ya seyahat edilmemesini tavsiye etmektedir.
advisory_headline.en: Due to ongoing armed conflict, flight limitations, and financial sanctions, major foreign offices advise against all travel to Russia.
advisory_headline.de: Wegen des bewaffneten Konflikts, Flugeinschränkungen und Bankensanktionen wird vor Reisen nach Russland gewarnt.
advisory_headline.ru: Действуют строгие международные финансовые и авиационные ограничения; иностранные карты Visa/Mastercard не работают.
advisory_headline.es: Debido al conflicto armado, restricciones aéreas y sanciones bancarias, cancillerías internacionales desaconsejan viajar a Rusia.

regional_warnings.area: Regions bordering Ukraine (Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, Voronezh, Rostov, Krasnodar)

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Russia reach approximately 32.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in urban Russian centers measure 88.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Foreign-issued Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards do not function in Russia due to sanctions; bring EUR or USD cash for currency exchange. MTS, MegaFon, and Beeline offer prepaid SIM cards requiring passport registration.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: International payment card systems have suspended operations within Russian territory

religion.value: Russian Orthodox Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, and Judaism as recognized historic faiths
religion.evidence_quote: Russian Orthodoxy is the largest traditional faith alongside substantial Muslim populations in Tatarstan and Caucasus

festivals.value: Victory Day (May 9), New Year celebrations, Maslenitsa pancake week, Scarlet Sails in St. Petersburg

sources.title: Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation

festivals.evidence_quote: Major national holidays include Victory Day, New Year, and the White Nights Scarlet Sails graduation

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Foreign citizens must carry original passports, migration cards, and hotel registration at all times. Photographing military sites, border areas, or transport hubs is strictly illegal. Non-cash payments require local Mir cards or UnionPay.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Foreigners must keep migration registration slips and documents available for police inspection

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants and cafés when satisfied with service; taxi fares can be rounded up to the nearest 100 rubles.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in Moscow and Saint Petersburg dining establishments
